title: Childcare & nursery
_note: English for work (english-for-work run, 2026-11-02): written by hand in British English, not yet checked by a second reader. translations.en = short definition in simple English; deHint = German translation (the 'German' tab). Words that already exist in the English lexicon are refs with a job-specific example.
intro: The words for work in a nursery or with small children: toys and materials, play, the daily routine, safety and talking to parents. Every word has an example sentence from a real working day in the UK.
introEasy: Do you work with small children? Learn the words for toys, play, the day and parents here.
tipps: Speak to small children in short, clear sentences and a warm voice: “Well done!”, “Let's wash our hands.”, “Shall we tidy up?”
When you talk to parents, start with something nice: “She's had a lovely day.” Then say what else they need to know.
If a child is hurt or ill, tell your room leader at once and write it down. Never wait until the end of the day.
